negative_controls.description: NO SECRET VALUE ANYWHERE. Grep all four new files for: a postgres connection-scheme prefix; a URL userinfo segment carrying a colon-separated secret before an at-sign; and a base64url-shaped run of 32+ bytes that is not a git object id and not an UPPER_SNAKE/kebab identifier. Any hit is RED. Measured PASS at authoring time via pnpm secrets:scan against the full working tree.

NO UTC TIMESTAMP IMPLEMENTING OD-3 ANYWHERE. Grep all four files for any ISO-8601 instant or Z-suffixed time presented as a VALID UNTIL value. Only the materialization_date literal 2026-09-22 may appear, and never as a computed expiry.
NEITHER CANONICAL LITERAL (SQ-6, SQ-7) APPEARS, in whole or composed from parts, in any of the four files.

AN UNANTICIPATED FIELD IS REJECTED, NOT SILENTLY ACCEPTED. Injecting an extra key (e.g. a vault-handle-shaped field) into execution_context and re-validating with ajv-cli must FAIL with an additionalProperties violation. Measured at authoring time: mutant with execution_context.vaultHandle injected reported 'must NOT have additional properties'.

A BLANK STRING IS REJECTED, NOT TREATED AS A VALID HOLE. Setting any hole_string field (e.g. execution_context.lane_identifier) to an empty string and re-validating must FAIL on minLength. Measured at authoring time: reported 'must NOT have fewer than 1 characters'. This is the schema's own enforcement of the lane mandate's 'never blanks interpreted as PASS'.

THIS ARTIFACT DOES NOT DECLARE N07 CLOSED IN THE DAG PACKAGE'S OWN LINEAGE. Grep the DAG authority, its v1.0.1 amendment and their companion manifest — none of the three files this lane's write set touches — for any edit. git diff against base 173fabce for those three paths must be EMPTY.
